digest.component_or_area: reusable four-pass code-review seam and project criteria extension
propositions: A net-new LLM-backed project code-review criterion merges via overlay but is silently dropped at five runtime points.
The criterion-id resolver hardcodes the plan-review prefix and excludes project ids.
The batch runner iterates only static built-in criteria, so project criteria are never fanned into Round A/B.
Pass-3 routing uses the packaged routing map instead of repository-aware effective routing, and eval/CLI surfaces reject project ids.
No project criterion dogfoods the four-phase boundary contract, so boundary drift goes uncaught.
An overlay-absent repo must behave byte-identically to today, preserving the 13 built-in overlays and default resolver mapping.
